summary: School librarian urges preservation of E-Rate program to ensure access to broadband for students and libraries.

claims.argument: Cutting E-Rate would force schools to cut other programs, exacerbating inequities
claims.evidence_quote: If e-rate funding is reduced or eliminated, schools will have to shoulder those costs, which will mean having to cut other valuable programs. We know that many districts in our state have already made the tough choice to eliminate services they know students benefit from in order to stay solvent.
